title: Spiced haddock with cauliflower
summary: Spiced haddock with cauliflower is a middle eastern dinner built around haddock fillets and cauliflower, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Heat the fan oven to 200°C. Cut the vegetables for Spiced haddock with cauliflower into even pieces and toss cauliflower with a teaspoon of the oil and a pinch of salt in the tin.
steps.tip: Even pieces cook at the same rate, so nothing is burnt while something else is still raw.

steps.instruction: Roast that first tray of cauliflower while you season haddock fillets. Pat it dry so the surface browns instead of steaming.
Nestle haddock fillets and ground cumin among the vegetables. Roast until the protein is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
steps.tip: Taste Spiced haddock with cauliflower before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Rest the tin for a few minutes, taste, and spoon Spiced haddock with cauliflower into warm bowls with the juices.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
